avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate immunosuppressive effects and increase bleeding risk in combination with immunotherapy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; obtain from dietary sources only

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May cause unpredictable immune stimulation or suppression, potentially interfering with atezolizumab's mechanism
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue at least 2 weeks before and during atezolizumab therapy

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May alter immune response and increase risk of immune-related adverse events
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modulate gut microbiome, potentially affecting immunotherapy efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Use with monitoring; discuss specific strain and timing with oncology team

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential immunomodulatory effects that may interact with checkpoint inhibitor mechanism
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for efficacy changes; maintain consistent dosing if continued

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive bleeding or bruising; maintain dosages <3g/day

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: While not metabolically significant for atezolizumab, may increase GI side effects and inflammatory responses

caution_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate fluid retention and hypertension associated with immunotherapy
caution_foods.action: Limit intake; maintain adequate hydration and monitor blood pressure

caution_foods.name: Charred/heavily grilled meats
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains heterocyclic amines that may trigger inflammatory responses
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; prefer steaming, baking, or boiling methods

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (>1-2 drinks/day)
caution_foods.mechanism: May impair immune function and increase hepatotoxicity risk
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; avoid binge drinking during treatment

monitoring_notes: Atezolizumab is a monoclonal antibody with minimal hepatic metabolism, making traditional drug-supplement interactions unlikely. Primary concerns focus on supplements and foods that modulate immune function or increase risk of immune-related adverse events (irAEs). Monitor for emerging irAEs including pneumonitis, colitis, hepatitis, and endocrinopathies.
